_comment: Capability guesses derived from package/command names and general knowledge of each server. They are NOT read from the servers' real tool lists. confidence: medium = well-known server whose purpose is documented; low = keyword guess. Extend with --annotate.

roles.untrusted_input: Brings text written by third parties into the model's context (web pages, issues, email, chat).
roles.private_data: Can read data that is private to you (local files, databases, private repositories, mail).
roles.egress: Can send data to someone else (outbound HTTP, messages, email, public comments or pushes, browser navigation).
roles.exec: Can run commands or code on your machine.
roles.write: Can modify or delete local data or remote records.
